statements.notes: Store in a cool, dry place with lid tightly closed to protect from humidity.
This product contains no sugar, starch, preservatives or artificial colors or flavoring.
Suggested Use: Adults take 5g (one scoop) 2 - 4 times daily, with water or meal.
This product is manufactured in a facility that processes other products which may contain soy, dairy, wheat, tree nuts, shellfish, peanuts and eggs.
This bottle was sealed for your protection. Do not use if inner or outer seal has been broken.

CAUTION: Do not exceed recommended dose. This product is not intended for pregnant or nursing mothers or children under the age of 18. Maintain sufficient fluid intake while taking this product. If you have a known medical condition and have questions about the advisability of taking this product, consult your physician prior to use.
